commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The ball goes out of play and Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.

90+2' 3 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Jordan Henderson, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Dango Ouattara (Brentford), who beats Martin Dubravka with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
90+1' Keith Andrews is forced to make a change. Igor Thiago (Brentford) is unable to continue due to injury, Keane Lewis-Potter comes on.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Burnley earn a corner.
86' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
86' 2 - 1 Goal! Igor Thiago (Brentford) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
85' Here is a change. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is going off and Keith Andrews gives the last tactical orders to Yegor Yarmolyuk.
85' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Zian Flemming (Burnley) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Caoimhin Kelleher no chance!
85' Zian Flemming (Burnley) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
85' Burnley are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score. Michael Kayode (Brentford) makes a slide tackle, but referee Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Josh Cullen as he is replaced by Armando Broja (Burnley).

77' Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Brentford.
75' It's time for a substitution. Josh Laurent (Burnley) comes on in place of Florentino.
75' Today's match ends for Loum Tchaouna who will be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).

75' Keith Andrews decides to make a substitution. Kevin Schade will be replaced by Reiss Nelson (Brentford).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rico Henry (Brentford) replaces Aaron Hickey.
69' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
67' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
64' Igor Thiago (Brentford) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
62' The corner kick from Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Burnley.
60' Substitution. Hannibal Mejbri makes his way off the pitch and Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) comes on as his replacement.
59' Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
56' The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
54' Brentford will take a corner kick.

53' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
52' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
51' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Igor Thiago (Brentford) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
49' Michael Kayode (Brentford) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

49' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) and Michael Kayode have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
47' Great teamplay by Brentford as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Burnley.
40' The free kick into the penalty area from Jordan Henderson (Brentford) is cleared.

35' Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
35' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
33' The ratio of the ball possession is 59:41.
28' Kevin Schade (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Brentford will take a throw-in.
28' Brentford are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
25' Kyle Walker (Burnley) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Kevin Schade (Brentford) was too aggressive in his challenge.
21' A spell of possession for Brentford in an attempt to control the game.
16' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Samuel Barrott ignores the protests.
15' Kyle Walker (Burnley) sends an accurate short pass. Martin Dubravka controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
13' The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
12' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley).
11' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' A player from Brentford commits a rough challenge. Samuel Barrott blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
4' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
3' Michael Kayode (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brentford.
1' Neat passing move from Burnley in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Brentford will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
